title: The List from Ten Thousand Years Ago
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's finger touched that name, the spiritual energy residue from ten thousand years ago suddenly surged, as if something was awakening—and that line of small characters seemed to mock his struggles: 'Number Forty-Nine, will end or begin the next ten-thousand-year chess game.'

text.content: The ancient stone wall shimmered with a cold, ethereal glow under the candlelight, its engravings remaining sharp and pristine despite countless millennia. Chen Ji stood before the wall, his breath nearly frozen. Forty-nine names descended in sequence, and the further he looked, the more his pupils contracted. Beside each name was annotated the manner and time of the seer's demise, densely recorded, a forgotten history of blood and tears. Until his gaze fell upon the lowest position, his name赫然在列: Number Forty-Nine, Chen Ji. The ink had dried for ten thousand years, yet appeared freshly applied, emanating an indescribable eeriness.

dialogue.content: The remnant soul's voice echoed hauntingly in his mind: 'See? This is the true cost of the Tianji Record—you believed yourself a chess piece, but from the very beginning, you were chosen as the terminator of this chess game.'

text.content: Chen Ji's finger hovered above the stone wall, yet he dared not touch it. He could feel his back drenched in cold sweat, his heartbeat thundering in his ears like war drums. Ten thousand years ago? His name appeared here ten thousand years ago? In that moment, he suddenly felt that all his struggles, forbearance, and scheming over more than twenty years resembled a ridiculous farce. If destiny was already fated, what meaning did all his resistance hold?

dialogue.content: '...Impossible.' Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice hoarse and unfamiliar to himself, 'This must be an illusion, a trial, or—' He abruptly turned, his gaze sweeping across the dark tunnel surrounding him, 'Who is playing games with me?'

text.content: No one answered him. Only the names on the stone wall flickered in the candlelight, like countless eyes from ten thousand years ago watching him through the darkness. He took a deep breath, forced himself tocalm下来, and began carefully observing the details on the stone wall. The forty-nine names were arranged in a spiral pattern; the earliest ones were already blurred and illegible, but as time progressed, the names grew increasingly clear, until the forty-ninth—his name—was not only clear, but the ink indeed appeared differently from the others, carrying a bizarre vividness.

choice.prompt: Faced with this truth capable of overturning cognition, Chen Ji needed to make a choice:

choices.description: Carefully examine whether there were other individuals with the surname Chen in the list, exploring the connection between the Chen family and the prophetic system
choices.visible_reward: Discover the Secret of the Chen Family Bloodline

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the churning emotions in his heart and shifted his gaze away from his own name, beginning to examine the forty-eight names above him one by one. His finger slowly moved along the stone wall and abruptly stopped at the seventh name—Chen Nian. These two characters struck like thunder, hitting the softest corner of his heart. He had believed his long-missing sister was merely taken by the Holy Sect, yet he never expected her to appear on this ten-thousand-year-old list under another name.

dialogue.content: 'Nian'er...' Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, 'She is also a seer?'

choices.text: Question Mo Xiansheng About the Truth
choices.description: Directly question the remnant soul guardian about what the Tianji Record truly is and why he was chosen

dialogue.content: 'You knew all of this from the start.' Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned cold, 'From the moment you first appeared, you were guiding me toward this place, weren't you?'

The remnant soul fell silent for a moment before finally sighing: 'What I know is far more than you imagined. But some truths require you to discover them yourself—for example, why does every generation of the Chen family have someone appear on this list.'

choices.text: Investigate the Clues Behind the List
choices.description: Don't dwell on your own name, but study the origin, material, and underlying power of this list

text.content: Chen Ji did not allow himself to fall into meaningless anger, but forced himself into a state ofanalyze calmly. He began examining the edges of the stone wall, the depth of the engravings, even the residual spiritual energy fluctuations in the air. Soon, he discovered a line of extremely small characters below the list, which would have been impossible to notice without the candlelight hitting just the right angle—the inscription read: 'Heavenly Fate Lock and Key, Bloodline Transmission, Forty-Ninth Generation, End or Begin.'

dialogue.content: 'Forty-Ninth Generation...' Chen Ji murmured repeating, suddenly understanding something, 'Does this mean that before me, there have already been forty-eight people named Chen Ji written into this list?'

text.content: Chen Ji's thoughts were swept by tumultuous waves. If this list was real, it meant the Chen family was not an ordinary cultivation clan, but a meticulously designed breeding ground for seers. Every generation would have someone selected for the list, then walk toward the same fate—death, or something even more terrible. And he himself was merely the forty-ninth chess piece in this cycle.

Yet at the same time, another thought quietly rose in his heart. If destiny had long been written, were all his previous arrangements, calculations, and the act of playing weak to devour the strong merely performances anticipated by those eyes watching from beyond ten thousand years? He suddenly recalled the bizarre voice when he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment: 'The Tianji Record selects its master, and only those of Chen bloodline can inherit it.' At the time, he had considered it mere coincidence; now, reflecting upon it, everything from the start was filled with meticulously designed traces.

dialogue.content: 'You're thinking, if everything is fated, whether your resistance still holds meaning.' The remnant soul's voice suddenly spoke, carrying an unfamiliar complex emotion Chen Ji had never heard before, 'But have you considered another possibility—the one who wrote this list might also be waiting for someone capable of rewriting the script.'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's words drew Chen Ji into deeper contemplation, and he decided:

choices.text: Search for Information on the Forty-Eighth
choices.description: If he was the Forty-Ninth Generation, what did the previous forty-eight 'Chen Ji' experience? What were their fates?

text.content: Chen Ji shifted his gaze to the position of the Forty-Eighth, only to find that name had been shrouded by a layer of peculiar light, and no matter how he stared, he couldn't see it clearly. The only distinguishable thing was the annotation beside the name: 'Fell under the first gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.' Seven characters, each heart-stopping. Chen Ji suddenly understood—being gazed upon by the Heavenly Dao's Eye might be the most terrifying curse for seers.

choices.description: What does Chen Nian's name appearing on the list mean? Is she also connected to the prophetic system?
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Clues Related to Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May Trigger the Stone Wall's Protection

dialogue.content: 'Tell me.' Chen Ji's voice suddenly became low and dangerous, 'Who exactly is Chen Nian? Why does she appear on this list? Where is she now?'

The remnant soul's voice carried hesitation for the first time: 'She is the Heavenly Fate Lock and Key, the only force capable of opening or completely sealing the Tianji Record. The Holy Sect took her precisely for this purpose—and now it seems, perhaps someone ten thousand years ago wished for this arrangement.'

text.content: Chen Ji's fists unconsciously clenched tight. Chen Nian, Heavenly Fate Lock and Key—these terms continuously echoed in his mind. He recalled his sister's last smile before she disappeared, and his mother's hand tightly gripping his as she lay dying, saying 'Take care of your sister.' He had always believed himself the one manipulating everything from the shadows, yet he never expected that from that moment, both he and his sister had been drawn into a chess game surpassing his comprehension.

A chill spread from his spine throughout his entire body. If Chen Nian's existence could interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight, then was the blurry vision he saw when he obtained the Fragment caused by his sister? Were those mists he had attributed to the Fragment's incompleteness actually a kind of protective mechanism? He suddenly realized that he might have always underestimated his sister's weight in this chess game.

dialogue.content: 'So...' Chen Ji's voice suddenly became exceptionally calm, a tone only he could make when suppressing anger, 'The Holy Sect wants her to control the Tianji Record; the Heavenly Dao's Eye wants her to ensure the prophecy proceeds according to script; and I—' he coldly smiled, 'I am merely the frontman pushed onto the stage, correct?'

text.content: The air in the tunnel seemed to solidify了几分. Chen Ji stood before the stone wall, gazing at his name, when he suddenly noticed that beside the two characters 'Chen Ji' there was an extremely faint engraving, invisible unless examined carefully. He drew close to examine it closely, his pupils suddenly contracting—that was an added later inscription, its brushwork different from the main text, yet it sent his entire body into an icy abyss: 'Number Forty-Nine, will end or begin the next ten-thousand-year chess game.'

choice.prompt: This phrase laden with implications presented Chen Ji with a final choice:

choices.description: Since the chess game is already fated, follow the script and observe the true intentions of the opponents
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Perspective of the Strategist

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly suppressing the fury threatening to burst through his理智. He suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a weariness and coldness of one who had seen through worldly affairs: 'Since you want me to perform this play, then I shall perform it for your viewing.' His gaze turned profoundly deep, 'But remember, the distance between a chess piece and a chess player is often merely one step.'

choices.description: Since this is destiny's shackles, destroy it physically and prove that will can conquer fate

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his hand, spiritual energy condensing into a sharp blade in his palm. Without hesitation, he slapped toward the stone wall—however, the anticipated scene of stone chips flying did not occur. His hand seemed obstructed by something, completely unable to touch those names. Immediately, a tremendous counterforce袭来, sending his entire body flying backward, heavily colliding with the stone wall behind him.

dialogue.content: 'Cough...' Chen Ji clutched his chest, spitting out a mouthful of blood, yet instead smiled, 'Cannot even be touched, it seems this list is more important than I imagined.' He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his eyes' light反而更加sharp, 'The more something is cherished, the more it demonstrates its value—if I cannot destroy you, then let me thoroughly see through you.'

text.content: The candlelight flickered in the tunnel, stretching Chen Ji's shadow long and short. He slowly rose from the ground, wiped away the blood from the corner of his mouth, and his gaze fell upon those forty-nine names once more. From the first to the forty-ninth, each had once been a living person in this world. They might have also struggled, resisted, attempted to break destiny's shackles, yet ultimately vanished in the long river of history, leaving only this cold list as proof of their existence.

But Chen Ji was not them. He crawled out from ruins, rose from among the dead. During those years working as a servant in the Tianqing Sect, he endured countless slights and bullying, yet never truly surrendered. He was accustomed to observing, calculating, scheming from the shadows, accustomed to concealing all his edge beneath a facade of wooden懦弱. It wasn't that he couldn't feel anger, but rather he transformed anger into an even more terrifying calm.

'Number Forty-Nine, will end or begin the next ten-thousand-year chess game.' Chen Ji silently repeated this phrase, suddenly sensing its profound meaning. This sentence itself was a paradox—ending and beginning, seemingly opposing yet actually unified. As the last seer, he could either walk toward destruction according to the script, or become the key to rewriting the rules. And this choice might have been left for him alone from the very beginning.

A strange sensation suddenly surged through his heart. Chen Ji下意识地 turned his head to gaze at the darkness behind him, vaguely seeming to perceive something writhing within that void. It was not a physical entity, but a gaze transcending the senses—as if some enormous existence was gazing down at him from high above the heavens, carrying ten-thousand-year patience and cold indifference. Heavenly Dao's Eye. For the first time, he sensed its presence so clearly, and the oppression brought by that gaze nearly rendered him breathless.

'It's here.' Chen Ji spoke softly, his voice terrifyingly calm. He did not evade that gaze, but instead walked toward it. The list from ten thousand years ago, ten thousand years of arrangement, his sister's whereabouts, the true face of the Heavenly Dao's Eye—all mysteries pointed to the same answer, and he had a premonition that answer was about to be revealed. At this moment, the candlelight suddenly剧烈摇曳起来, as if some force was approaching. Chen Ji stood before the stone wall, gazing at his name, the corners of his mouth lifting into a meaningful arc. Whether ahead lay a chess game or an abyss, he was already prepared—after all, he was the one capable of giving even heaven a headache.
